message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine statutory charge(s) based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: unauthorized logging (cutting trees) without logging permit, instructing others to cut trees on contracted land, causing forest damage. Likely charge: "非法采伐森林木材罪" (illegal logging of forest trees) under Criminal Law article 338? Actually article 338 deals with illegal logging of forest trees, causing damage. Also possibly "破坏森林资源罪". In Chinese law, "非法采伐、毁坏森林资源罪" (illegal logging, destroying forest resources). The typical charge: "非法采伐森林木材罪". Let's see: Under Criminal Law of PRC, Article 338: "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护的森林、珍贵树种或者其他森林资源，情节严重的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节特别严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So charge: "非法采伐森林木材罪". Also could be "破坏森林资源罪". Usually the term used is "非法采伐森林木材罪". So answer: [罪名]非法采伐森林木材罪<eoa>

Check if multiple charges: maybe also "非法占用农用地罪"? But the land is contracted, but they cut trees on that land. The main crime is illegal logging. So single charge.

Thus final answer.
